originality.rationale: The proved headline (genus-one kernel, infinite theta order, rho/r/p constants with irrational p) is already recorded/covered by the BMM finite/infinite classification plus Bostan-Raschel-Salvy (BRS) Tables 1-2 for the 51 nonsingular infinite-group models. S2={W,S,N,NE} is nonsingular (has (-1,0),(0,-1)) so lies in BRS scope; BRS already lists rho~3.799605, excursion exponent ~2.610604=1+p, mu_rho=t^4+t^3-8t^2-36t-11 identical to our rho resultant, and mu_c polynomials that are exact scalings of the claimed fT/R/hT (e.g. 256S^4+64S^3-48S^2+12S-1 with S=r^2; fT(2t)/16 equals BRS mu_c for the same family). Infinite group itself is the BMM classification fact (finite order bounded, checkable by iteration); the fixed-point eigenvalue proof is a new certificate for a known fact, and certification alone does not create originality per STANDARD. The genuinely new part (Q(0,1;t) non-D-finiteness) is explicitly NOT proved. Hence the claim is a recomputation/certificate of a known stronger excursion fact, failing the adversarial coverage checklist.

value.rationale: Judged as EMERGENT_FINDING with no preset value presumption. The object S2 is natural and motivated, but the exact invariant is already known: BRS supplies the same rho to 6 decimals, same exponent 2.610604, same minimal polynomials, and the irrationality theorem for all 51 models. Narrow rigorous intervals (width ~1e-5 for p) and a second proof of infiniteness add only a tiny unmotivated gain over the published tables, with no new downstream use demonstrated beyond what BRS/Denisov-Wachtel already enable. Per STANDARD, certification and replayability strengthen but do not create value, and known-database recomputation must be rejected even if correct and narrowly new. The unfinished y-boundary census is honestly described and does not rescue value because the headline datum itself is already covered.
